patthana19.4:1.1: na upādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana19.4:2.1: na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: pañca.
patthana19.4:3.1: na anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana19.4:4.1: na upādinnupādāniyañca na anupādinnaanupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana19.4:5.1: na anupādinnupādāniyañca na anupādinnaanupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca upādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
patthana19.4:6.1: na upādinnupādāniyañca na anupādinnupādāniyañca dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi.
